title: Hochschild theory of multiplicative sequences of algebras and coalgebra measurings
summary: We study coalgebra measurings between multiplicative sequences of algebras and the maps induced by them on Hochschild homology. The Hochschild theory of multiplicative sequences is introduced as a functor taking values in graded algebras in the symmetric monoidal category of chain complexes, constructed with the help of the shuffle product. We develop the universal measuring coalgebra, or Sweedler Hom for multiplicative sequences, as well as study several other Sweedler operations in this context.
